title: Radiant Revelry welcomes 130+ new undergraduates
excerpt: Celebrating IEEE WIE Day with the E22 batch — mini-games, a treasure hunt and a talk from Princeton.
content: Radiant Revelry was a vibrant, interactive event celebrating IEEE WIE Day with the newly enrolled E22 undergraduates. Over 130 participants joined mini-games, a thrilling treasure hunt and a recorded talk by Ms. Anuththara Rupasinghe, a postdoctoral research associate at Princeton University.
